connector.name: Web Task by rich-jojo
connector.registryDescription: Browser tasks, sessions, and recipes for MCP and HTTP automation.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package web-task-api. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the rich-jojo account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: WEB_TASK_API_DATA_DIR
env.description: Optional mutable data root for web-task-api runs, sessions, profiles, and temp state. When omitted, the runtime uses a platform user-data directory instead of the ambient cwd.

env.name: WEB_TASK_API_RECIPES_DIR
env.description: Optional recipes directory override. When omitted, web-task-api reads bundled recipes from the installed package.

env.name: WEB_TASK_API_TEMP_DIR
env.description: Optional temp root override used when incoming temp env variables point at your home directory or working directory.

env.name: CLIPROXY_BASE_URL
env.description: Optional CLIProxy base URL for the cliproxy planner backend.

env.name: CLIPROXY_AUTH_TOKEN
env.description: Optional CLIProxy auth token for the cliproxy planner backend.

env.name: CLIPROXY_MODEL
env.description: Optional CLIProxy model alias for the cliproxy planner backend.

env.name: OPENCODE_BASE_URL
env.description: Optional OpenCode base URL for the opencode planner backend.

env.name: OPENCODE_MODEL
env.description: Optional OpenCode model name for the opencode planner backend.

env.name: BROWSER_USER_DATA_DIR
env.description: Optional existing Chromium/Chrome user-data directory for warmed browser state reuse.

env.name: BROWSER_CHANNEL
env.description: Optional Playwright browser channel override, for example `chrome`.

env.name: HEADLESS
env.description: Optional browser headless toggle. Set `false` to prefer a visible browser.
